messages:
katie: FYI console spotted weird oscillation in the token-cost sparklines during last night's rollout. Looks like per-model unit cost flips between windows.
omar: Can you paste the window sample? Is this the rollout card or the tenant cost card?
katie: rollout card. window samples: ```ts,window_start,model_variant,tokens,compute_ms,cached_tokens
3612342000,3612342000,model-X:1200,960000,4820000,12000
3612342300,3612342300,model-X-small:300,240000,1200000,8000```
lee: That second row has cached_tokens non-zero but compute_ms low; our amortization currently subtracts cached tokens from denom which can artificially inflate per-token cost when variants switch.
tara: Is this a sampling artifact? The rollout card uses micro-windows (5m) and we had a 50/50 split at 00:04 during the canary. Splitting ratios across windows gives strange averages.
omar: Short-term: widen rollout micro-window to 10m so the split lives in fewer windows. Longer-term we should return per-window variant histograms and compute weighted unit cost as sum(compute_ms)/sum(tokens_total) where tokens_total includes cached_tokens.
katie: Also want a tiny UI affordance: add a "show variant mix" chevron on the rollout card so SREs can see if a spike aligns with routing churn.
lee: Implementation detail: telemetry schema add field `variant_histogram` as compact CSV: "model-X:1200,model-X-small:300" and `tokens_cached` as integer. Keep top-K=3.
tara: Client-side recompute is cheap. We can fetch the histogram for the hovered tenant and compute unit_cost_preview = sum(compute_ms_i)/sum(tokens_total_i).
omar: Edge: quantized variants have different compute_ms semantics; include `quant_state` suffix or a parallel small CSV `variant_quant=\"model-X:int8,model-X-small:none\"`.
katie: Billing note: label recomputed values as "preview - not invoiced". Billing folks asked we keep invoice math unchanged.
econ-bot: Created ticket INF-9909 (telemetry: variant_histogram + tokens_cached), INF-9910 (rollout card micro-window change), INF-9911 (UI: show variant mix + client-side recompute).
lee: Action items: (1) omar to prototype ingestion changes to emit histogram + cached tokens (2) tara to flip rollout micro-window to 10m in staging for 24h (3) katie to add the chevron mock to the rollout card.
omar: Will post a minimal payload example on the RFC thread.
katie: thanks all. hope this reduces the surprise spikes during canaries. :thumbsup:
